Before arrival, confirm that you are accepted into an approved full-time course in Singapore and that you need a Student’s Pass. You can submit the application while still in Vietnam; you do not need to be in Singapore while it is processed. Submit it at least two months and no more than three months before your course begins. Prepare the required documents, photo, Registration Acknowledgement Letter, and processing fee. After approval, enter Singapore to complete the formalities for issuing the pass.

DO THIS

Check whether your current immigration status exempts you from needing a Student’s Pass.

Confirm that your institution and course are on ICA’s list of approved full-time programmes.

Confirm that your course is full-time and is not conducted only in the evenings or on weekends.

Submit the application two to three months before the course begins.

Pay the non-refundable S$45 processing fee using an accepted payment method.

After approval, enter Singapore to complete the Student’s Pass formalities.

PREPARE

Original documents required for the application.

Official English translations for documents that are not in English.

Properly attested or notarized translations, where applicable.

A recent passport-sized digital colour photo taken within the last three months.

Your school’s Registration Acknowledgement Letter.

Payment through Visa, MasterCard, American Express, Internet Direct Debit, or PayNow.

If you hold a valid Dependant’s Pass, Long-Term Visit Pass, or Immigration Exemption Order, you may not need a Student’s Pass; verify your status and whether it remains valid for your full study period.

The standard processing time is within one week, or two weeks if a Visa is required.

If you change schools after approval but before collecting the pass, you must submit a new application.

The evidence does not specify Vietnam-specific documents or whether a Visa will be required for you.
